### Slice audited
`cli-core`: `packages/cli-core/cliapp`, `packages/cli-core/cliutil`, and `scenarios/prompt-manager/cli` bootstrap.

### Dimension grades
Architecture B; security B; test coverage B; documentation B-; cross-platform C+; signal C; instrumentation C.

### Top finding
Structured API recovery metadata is parsed and tested in `cli-core`, but user-facing CLI output drops it. A local fixture returning HTTP 400 with `code`, `recovery_hint`, and `manual_steps` produced only `Last error: api error (400): fixture failure`.

### Measurement plan
Add a shared `cli-core` error presenter and a CLI-level stderr contract test requiring structured API errors to expose code/recovery/manual steps.

No direct `docs/infra-health` edits. Decision proposes routing this into the infra-health instrumentation/signal plan and platform backlog.

### Dimension grades
Architecture B; security B; test coverage B+; documentation B-; cross-platform B; signal C+; instrumentation C+.

### Top finding
The API exposes global active heartbeat run inspection and stop controls, but the `prompt-manager` CLI has no operator command for `GET /heartbeats/running` or `POST /heartbeats/running/{teamId}/{agentId}/stop`. Parity marks both as `audit-pending`.

### Measurement plan
Add CLI contract tests for active-run list and stop commands, then mark both parity entries covered only after those tests pass.
